style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE hazel grouse, barred grey brown plumage, black throat, small crest; same bird
second_characters: squirrel couriers in caps, huge at the lens

props.tray: ONE metal roasting tray, his size, handed to him
props.skewer: ONE long skewer, carried under a wing

environment: parcel yard at noon, box stacks filling the frame to its top edge, no open sky, cardboard and tape drifting
lighting: flat white daylight from above, cool edge on the left, warm fill on the right
motion_rule: the hero hops and flaps from stack to stack across the yard, never still from the first frame to the last: wings thrown the full frame width, filling half the frame height, beak to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: boxes, tape and couriers rush at the glass every beat. New shot size every beat, medium to close. One hero action per beat.

audio.rate: 3.2 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 5.60, then the tray
audio.lip_sync: the bird himself speaks on camera, beak to the lens in every spoken beat, beak opens on every syllable, empty while speaking, props under the wing
audio.pronunciation: kor-ZI-na, pus-TA, ye-SHCHO, mar-ket-PLEYS, ZNA-yet, NUZH-no

timeline.a: hops off a stack the full frame width, ripping a box apart in the air; a courier throws a box into the glass
lands and whips the full width along the stacks, cardboard bursting off him; a courier tumbles across the lens
hurls the emptied box into the lens, body twisting after it; two couriers catch it at the glass
flaps back the other way over the boxes, tail sweeping edge to edge; a courier climbs the lens with a fresh box
tears the fresh box open on the move, ONE tray flashes out, he swings it the full width; couriers pour over the lens
hops two stacks on with the tray, beak to the lens; a courier flings the skewer past the glass
a courier jams the skewer under his wing as he sweeps past; three couriers shoot through the lens
beats both wings at the wall of boxes, it collapses into the lens; couriers dive out of it
runs the falling boxes down the full frame width; a courier shakes a herb bunch open at the glass
two couriers shove the tray at him as he hops past, he takes it in both wings on the move, beak to the lens
couriers slide the tray under him right across the frame and he lands in it, wings thrown edge to edge
a courier stabs the skewer upright beside him and swings a cardboard lid in across the lens
couriers drag the tray across the frame by its rims, his beak sweeping through the lens, herbs raining on him
cardboard and tape sweep across the lens, the box stacks rushing past behind the tray

must_appear: at 0.00 in the air off a stack tearing a box; the tray out at 2.25; shoved at him on the move at 5.60, his own size; he lands in it at 6.30, wings full width; the skewer upright beside him at 7.05
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, black bars, night, dark scene, studio lamps, light fixtures, open sky, a prop worked in place, a prop in the beak while speaking, a hero running on his feet, hero riding a belt or cart, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, a motionless first or last second, speech after 5.60, offscreen narration, dubbed voice, English speech, a second grouse
